subject: general
question: The annual increase in percentage of a population is 5% and the present number of people is 16,000. What will be the population in three years?
solution:
Given:

P = 16,000

R = 5% (increase)

n = 3 years

Formula Used:

Population n years later = P(1 + (R)/(100))n

Calculation:

∴ According to the question:

⇒ P(1 + (R)/(100))n

⇒ 16,000(1 + (5)/(100))3

⇒ 16,000((21)/(20) × (21)/(20) × (21)/(20))

⇒ 16,000 × ((21× 21 × 21))/((20 × 20 × 20))

⇒ 2 × 21 × 21 × 21

⇒ 18,522

∴ 3 years later, the population of the town will be 18,522.
